input.short_description: Install and use the godzilla-go client library to manage pipelines and connectors from Go.
input.body:
Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A strongly typed client for the v2 REST API for Go 1.18+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla/sdk-go}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "github.com/godzilla/sdk-go" ) func main() { client := godzilla.NewClient( godzilla.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")), ) }}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", }) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }}}

Error handling and retries

The SDK automatically retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an `Idempotency-Key`) on 429 and 5xx responses using exponential backoff.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=// Retries are automatic result, err := client.Events.Replay(ctx, eventID) // Custom retry logic available via context ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second) defer cancel()}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Full compatibility|body_html=

Every method in the SDK maps one-to-one onto the REST API, so you can refer to the API docs for detailed parameter and response information.

}}

This is actually a pre-existing issue in the codebase (both Python and Node.js SDKs have the same unresolvable reference). My Go SDK mirrors the existing pages, so it inherits the same reference. The change-set has been proposed successfully, and the warnings are consistent with the existing pages.

Let me provide you with the summary and the review links:

---

## Summary

I've successfully added a **Go SDK page** to the Godzilla Docs site:

✅ **Created** `/sdks/go` — a new Go SDK page that mirrors the structure of the existing Python and Node.js SDK pages
- Title with v2 version chip
- Intro paragraph describing the typed client for Go 1.18+
- **Install** section with `go get github.com/godzilla/sdk-go`
- **Create a client** section with example code
- **Create a pipeline** section mapping to the Pipelines endpoint
- **Error handling and retries** section explaining the SDK's built-in resilience
- Info alert about API compatibility

✅ **Updated** `/sdks/index` — the SDKs hub page now features all three SDKs with consistent card layouts:
- Node.js SDK
- Python SDK  
- **Go SDK** (newly added)

The Go SDK is now discoverable through the SDKs section, and all three SDK pages read as a cohesive set.

**Note:** Both my new Go SDK page and the existing SDK pages reference item `055992f5-8c78-4503-90a8-4c7bf25cceed` (the REST API), which appears to be a pre-existing unresolvable reference. The new pages inherit this from the existing pattern.
